message.content: Hey, I just got off shift. My brain is fried. Can you help me draft a quick message to the pottery club instructor? Inès needs to know if she should bring her own apron for the session this Wednesday.

content.text: Of course, Claire. Rest a bit first. Here is a draft you can send: "Bonjour Madame, Inès will be attending the session this Wednesday. Could you please confirm if she needs to bring her own apron, or if one will be provided? Thank you!" Shall I send this to her contact?

message.content: Yes, please send it. Also, while you're at it, check the calendar. I have that doctor's appointment for Hugo on Thursday morning, right? I keep mixing up the days with these rotating shifts.

content.text: I’ve checked your calendar. Your appointment for Hugo is actually scheduled for Friday, March 11th, at 9:00 AM. I’ve already sent a reminder notification to your phone for tomorrow evening. Is there anything else you need to organize before you go to sleep?

message.content: Thanks. That’s a relief. No, just the usual worry that I forgot something. I’ll go make some tea and check on the kids. Talk later.
